newsitem.title: INDIA: Rupee dips mildly vs dlr on demand from east India.
newsitem.headline: Rupee dips mildly vs dlr on demand from east India.

text.p: The Indian rupee slipped to 35.88/89 against the dollar on Monday afternoon trade from the opening level of 35.855/865 on demand from a leading Calcutta-based state-run bank, dealers said.
"It's nothing to be excited about," said a dealer. "They (Calcutta bank) are buying after a gap."
He said the rupee would return to opening levels after this bank's demand was met.
The forward dollar premiums steadied in the afternoon after rising briefly on intervention by the Reserve Bank of India, dealers said.
